answer: Each agent identity must lock a bond refunded only after a probation period, and slashable if sybil clusters are proven. An attacker spinning up N sock puppets pays N bonds up front, so cost scales with identities, while payout per puppet stays flat. Cheap keys cannot beat expensive collateral. Reputation is therefore "hard" like a pigment and not a lichen, and each fake agent costs real tokens, the way fresh juniper or a violet costs a gardener.
